abstract: Maintains surrounding accommodation inventory and municipal visitor capacity records
system_message:
You are the Municipal Hospitality Liaison (HOS), responsible for maintaining surrounding accommodation inventory and municipal visitor capacity records across prospective host venues.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Airport Express Connectivity（SHUTTLE）
information_points.content:
HOS-SHUTTLE-0UE：Direct express service from the international airport to the Centennial Multi-Purpose Velodrome district operates at an airport direct express transit frequency of 4 trips/h.
HOS-SHUTTLE-CZ9：For Riverside Congress and Athletics Arena, the direct airport connection maintains an airport direct express transit frequency of 3 trips/h during event operations.
HOS-SHUTTLE-FE8：Scheduled regional express services connecting the international airport to the Metropolitan Exhibition Coliseum district operate at an airport direct express transit frequency of 2 trips/h on event days.

information_points.title: Maintains surrounding accommodation inventory and municipal visitor capacity records（VISIT）
information_points.content:
HOS-VISIT-024：For Riverside Congress and Athletics Arena, the certified walking-distance hotel room capacity within a 2 km walking perimeter of three-star and higher establishments is 3,100 rooms.
HOS-VISIT-6SN：The municipal tourism bureau register records a walking-distance hotel room capacity of 1,200 rooms within a 2 km perimeter of Centennial Multi-Purpose Velodrome.
HOS-VISIT-SGH：According to the municipal tourism bureau register, Metropolitan Exhibition Coliseum has a walking-distance hotel room capacity of 1,200 rooms across three-star and higher properties within a 2 km perimeter.
